exposure: serum gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase to platelet ratio (GPR)
cohort: One hundred parturients from a tertiary hospital, divided into a HELLP group (n=50) and a control group (n=50).
finding: Higher GPR, ALT, and UA were identified as independent risk factors for HELLP syndrome, with GPR demonstrating superior predictive efficacy for HELLP syndrome compared to other markers and correlating with preterm birth.
